author: Cinna Davis (OpenAI Codex assisted)
statement: Explicit low-load quadratic sparse-query systems require n(L-1) binary XOR gates under disjoint-support sharing for the given rows; L=floor(log2 n)-2. This is not a SAT lower bound or an improved SAT algorithm. For power-of-two n, an exact row-space reduction counts the same family in polynomial time via a cycle independent-set formula. For arbitrary n, a kernel-parameterized exact algorithm uses poly(n) 2^d time and polynomial space, with d bounded by gcd(n_odd, 2^L-1). This enumeration has d=(n-5)/10 on an explicit infinite subsequence.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size argument

A complete all-input algorithm and cost for any SAT improvement
